solutions.title: Binary search
solutions.notes: Binary search — O(log n) insert point
solutions.description:
**Approach:** Classic binary search; when not found, `left` is the insert index.

**Why preferred:** The problem is in the binary-search family; linear scan misses the point.

**Example walkthrough:** Binary search for `2` in `[1, 3, 5, 6]`. The search ends with `lo = 1`, the insert index.

solutions.title: Linear findIndex
solutions.description:
**Approach:** First index where `nums[i] >= target`, else `nums.length`.

**vs recommended:** Correct lower-bound semantics. Upgrade to binary search for the expected complexity and topic practice.

**Example walkthrough:** `findIndex` finds the first value `>= 2`, which is `3` at index `1`.
